# Darshan A S — Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Darshan A S, an Associate Software Engineer at Texas AI in Bengaluru, India. Building with code and editing videos. React + Vite + Tailwind single-page site with a dark/light theme and keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+K search, Ctrl+' quotes, d theme toggle).

## Important URLS

- https://darshan-as.vercel.app/ (main portfolio)
- https://darshan-as.vercel.app/otherside (video editing showreel page)
